dynamic_limitations: AST analysis does not prove interface dispatch, reflection, generated code or runtime registration; those paths remain explicit uncertainty.

reachability_rule: A target symbol is a reachable anchor only when a production CallExpr from the listed public CLI construction/transport prefixes is cited; downstream target-to-target edges are retained separately.
